verdict.rationale: CrewAI ships an official CLI (crewai) installable via a single command that includes a create command to scaffold new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template projects, and docs describe a ready-to-paste setup prompt so a coding agent can install the CLI and scaffold projects itself. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on confirmation that the one-command scaffold flow works smoothly, and no walkthrough example of the generated template project structure.
